facts.rawText:
Hyaluronic + PGA 2% Face Serum

Intense, Multi-Level Hydration without the Oily Feel

## What Makes It Potent?
- This fast absorbing formula contains a blend of 2 highly powerful hydrators - Hyaluronic Acid & Polyglutamic Acid. Together they provide multi-level hydration & instant plump look
- Contains 4 different types of Hyaluronic Acid molecules of varying molecular weight & properties for providing surface level as well as deeper hydration. The smallest molecule has molecular weight of just 6kDa (smaller the molecule, deeper its penetration in the skin)
- Highly concentrated Glyceryl Glucoside for stimulating the formation of Aquaporin water channels in skin cells. This in turn improves transportation of water between cells
- Copper Ferment improves osmose level of dermal external fluid and keeps hydration level high. Natto & Biosaccharide gum prevents TEWL (Transepidermal Water Loss) Formulated with best ingredients sourced from leading global suppliers. Our Hyaluronic comes from Jan Dekker, Netherlands and Glyceryl Glucoside from BASF, Germany

## Ideal For
Skin type: Dry/Normal, Sensitive, Oily/Combination, Acne-ProneConcerns: Dry, Dehydrated & Skin TightnessSuitable for: 16+ years of agePregnancy/Lactation: Safe

## Clinical Results
To evaluate the efficacy of this new formulation, we conducted a clinical study in an independent third party testing lab and tested this serum against Hyaluronic Acid serum of an international brand that creates active ingredient based products (called Benchmark here). Results of the study are shared below.Minimalist Hyaluronic + PGA 2% serum provided significantly higher hydration than the benchmark product. Throughout the 8 hours testing window, our serum provided ~26% more hydration than the benchmark product.Study objective: To evaluate and compare hydration benefit up to 8 hours post product application in comparison to baseline, benchmark and untreated controlInstrument used: Corneometer & TewameterStudy report no: SKIN/USHS/SR/2021-147(Based on a monocentric, double blinded, comparative, forearm study-evaluation conducted by MS Clinical Research Lab - an independent testing lab)

## How to Use
Take a pea-sized amount on your fingertips, and apply on the face and neck. For best results, follow it with a moisturiser to lock in the hydration within the skin.When to use: AM & PM everyday

## Consumer Studies
Hyaluronic Acid & Polyglutamic Acid are potent hydrators & we got the product's efficacy evaluated through a consumer study.93% subjects noticed less dryness & hydrated skin in 4 weeks90% subjects said skin stayed hydrated throughout the day97% subjects felt skin felt soft & plump immediately upon applicationNote: The product has been evaluated for safety through patch testing under the supervision of a Dermatologist.

## Hyaluronic Acid
4 different types of Hyaluronic Acid molecules

## Polyglutamic Acid
A potent humectant that holds 4 times more water than hyaluronic acid and is one of the most hydrating ingredient in industry right now

## Glyceryl Glucoside
Highly purified molecule that stimulates Aquaporin channels in epidermis

## All Ingredients
Water/Aqua, Glycerin, Butylene Glycol, Dimethyl Isosorbide, Sodium Hyaluronate Crosspolymer, Ethoxydiglycol, Methyl Gluceth-20, 1,2-Hexanediol, Glyceryl Glucoside, Sodium Polyglutamate, Trehalose, Panthenol, Sodium Hyaluronate, Saccharomyces/Copper Ferment, Hydrolyzed Sodium Hyaluronate, Sodium Acetylated Hyaluronate, Pentylene Glycol, Biosaccharide Gum-1, Phenoxyethanol, Chlorphenesin, Ethylhexylglycerin
